summary: If you are quietly supplying the missing time, money, or clarity that keeps a plan alive, the plan is not functioning as well as everyone says it is.
body: If you are quietly supplying the missing time, money, or clarity that keeps a plan alive, the plan is not functioning as well as everyone says it is. When Saturn squares Neptune, responsibility and idealism grind against each other until the gap between the vision and the support underneath it becomes impossible to keep covering. You can believe deeply in the purpose without volunteering to disguise every weakness in the structure. Your ability to compensate is not proof that the arrangement works.
